quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals press release: Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) plus Chemotherapy Demonstrates (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jazz announced second interim top-line overall survival (OS) results from the Phase 3 HERIZON-GEA-01 trial: Ziihera (zanidatamab-hrii) plus chemotherapy demonstrated statistically significant and clinically meaningful OS improvement versus trastuzumab plus chemotherapy in first-line HER2+ locally advanced or metastatic GEA, and with longer follow-up the OS hazard ratios of both the Ziihera plus chemotherapy arm and the Ziihera plus Tevimbra (tislelizumab-jsgr) and chemotherapy arm improved compared with the first interim analysis. The safety profile was generally consistent with the known profile of each agent, with no new safety signals observed. Jazz has submitted the data for presentation at a major medical meeting in the fourth quarter 2026 and will also submit them to global health authorities. The global, randomized, open-label trial, run jointly with BeOne Medicines, randomized 914 patients from approximately 225 sites in more than 30 countries, with dual primary endpoints of PFS per BICR and OS.
quarterly_data.figure: Ziihera plus chemotherapy OS statistically significant at second interim analysis; OS hazard ratios of both Ziihera arms improved vs first interim; data submitted for presentation at a major medical meeting in fourth quarter 2026; 914 patients, approximately 225 sites, more than 30 countries
